title: LLM-personalized Parsons programming problems
summary: Students solve Parsons problems whose surface context and programming concepts are customized through a large language model. They arrange shuffled code blocks into a correct solution, allowing instructors to offer varied practice while retaining the structural constraints of the underlying problem.

sources.title: Automating Personalized Parsons Problems with Customized Contexts and Concepts

assessment.summary: Arrange shuffled code blocks to solve an LLM-customized Parsons programming problem.
student_actions: Order and, where required, indent code blocks to form a correct program.

student_role.description: The LLM customizes the problem before delivery; students solve the resulting Parsons problem.

assessment_system_role: Customize problem contexts and targeted programming concepts.

grading.method: The Parsons environment checks the assembled solution.
